name: discordia-rest-swaps-levels-by-its-music-counters-and-is-banished-at-end-phase
notes: The generator filed this printed ACTIVATED ability in the play-time $cardActivatedAbilities table, so the field click was routed through ActivateCard (the item treated as a card being played): the effect ran but the printed REST / banish-self / sacrifice cost was never paid and the item could be re-used for free every time. Registered as a field activation ($activateAbilityAbilities in Custom/GameLogic.php; ActivatedAbilityCost pays the cost) and the play-time body neutralized in Custom/GeneratedAbilityOverrides.php. The generated follow-up handler also read an undefined $musicCount (a PHP warning that made the level swap a no-op); the music count is now carried in the handler parameter.

rulesClauses: [REST]: Target champion gets -X level and your champion gets +X level until end of turn, where X is the amount of music counters on CARDNAME. At the beginning of the next end phase, banish CARDNAME.

engineBug.summary: Discordia never rested and its level swap used an undefined variable.
